[06]Hey, big bro! I heard an interesting rumor. You know that Susa? Turns out he's a real crook!
[06]He's set up a hideout on the cape up north and he's pulling some seriously nasty stuff. Guess he was just a crook after all.
[06]Oh, I'd better get going! ▼|See ya, big bro! I've got a feeling we'll meet again somewhere!

Forgive us for the other day. I am the village chief. ▼ [07]Now, would you be willing to hear us out?|
[07]As you've probably heard already, this village doesn't have a single drop of water.
[07]Our village has always been in the desert, but thanks to the lake to the east, we used to have plenty of water.
[07]But then one day, a castle appeared in the mountains to the north, and things took a terrible turn.
[07]Demon beasts started roaming around. They built a dam on the lake to the east and stole our village's water.
[07]We tried many times to destroy the dam... ▼ [07]but it's guarded by demon beasts and ESP, so we can't break it.
[07]That's when we heard rumors of a powerful bomb called the "PK Bomb."
[07]We had a man called Ryuichi slip out of the village to search for it, but...
[07]His last message, from "Gasoline Town," said "the PK Bomb is in the ruins"... ▼ [07]and then he went missing.
[07]Please! Find the "PK Bomb" and save our village!
That's... the "PK Bomb"!
[07]Y-you finally got it! ▼|Now we're saved!
[07]There's one more thing... ▼|Would you do us another favor?|
»Sure%| »Not again%
[07]Please don't say that! I beg you!|
[07]Just east of this village, there's a dam between the mountains and the lake.
[07]If you use the bomb in front of the dam, you can destroy it.
[07]Please! Destroy the dam!
Truly... I don't know how to thank you...
S... so it's you... It's me... Ryuichi. Under... this house...
[07]The "PK... Bomb" is... here... but... I couldn't... bring it back...
[07]The rest... is up to you... Save... the Mountain... Village... ▼ [07]And... this... I won't... need it... anymore...

[06]Bad news: we can't find him. He seems to have run into one of the many hidden rooms on the second floor.
[06]That's bad. They say there are lots of rooms on that second floor that even we don't know about.
[06]Exactly. Uryuu and Yukishiro have been caught and the "ritual" is about to begin. This mess is the last thing we need.
[06]Plus, they say Susa is not far away.
[06]Yeah. That's not good at all.
By the way, why are we searching so hard for the guy who ran off?
[06]It seems he's trying to tell Susa about Uryuu and Yukishiro.
[06]Susa? The guy who defeated the first Lord Susano Oh?
[06]That's right. They say if he meets Uryuu and Yukishiro, it could be the end of us forces of evil.
[06]Hey! Who's that?! It's a human! This is bad!
We've got him cornered in the northeast!
|Where in the northeast?!
|Go to the northeast corner. The hidden room is on the left! Hurry!

[06]The key is just inside the door on the first floor...?
[06]And tell me the order.
[06]The pillars on the third floor, in this order: southwest, northwest, southeast, northeast. It's time now, so it should open.
[06]The "key" is gone! Susa must have taken it!
[06]Even if he did take it, he'd never figure out that you use the key on the four pillars on the third floor in the order southwest, northwest, southeast, northeast.
[06]Besides, the key won't work until the time of the "ritual" comes. And the time is right now.
[06]Ah! Susa! Uryuu?! How did you escape?!

[06]Me? I'm after the treasure they say Susano Oh's been collecting.
[06]Ah, big bro, that's MY treasure! No muscling in, got it?
[06]Huh, the "ritual"? Come to think of it, a demon beast said something just now about the "ritual" being held on the roof...
[06]It was going on about a key and the pillars on the third floor or something...
[06]You're leaving already? Aw, I'll miss you. Well, big bro! See you around!
The moment you stepped onto the floor, it sank down with a rumble!
Wh-who's there?!
[06]I don't know who you are, but thank you for saving me! My name is Snow.
[06]The day that decides whether evil or light will rule the universe is drawing near.
[06]Two of the three who hold the key to it, Yukishiro and Uryuu, are being held prisoner in this castle!
[06]And Susano Oh intends to kill Uryuu and Yukishiro, to make sure evil wins.
[06]To stop that, we have to rescue those two!
[06]Let's hurry! The "ritual" to erase them both from this world is about to begin!
